newsitem.title: USA: U.S. court partially stays credit union ruling.
newsitem.headline: U.S. court partially stays credit union ruling.

text.p: A U.S. appeals court Tuesday issued a partial stay of a lower court decision in October limiting membership in federal credit unions.

The district court decision said credit unions could not accept new members who were not part of the groups they serve. The appeal court stay said credit unions could enroll new members from all of the employee groups they had been serving prior to the October 25 decision.
The stay is in effect until the Supreme Court decides if it will hear an appeal of the decision. The National Credit Union Administration hailed the stay order.
